name: Pitch Deck Coach
description: Reads through a deck and tells you what a funder would actually take away from it — the parts that land, the parts that invite awkward questions, the parts that vanish. Useful once you have slides to test; it improves argument and evidence, not visual design.

official.title: Pitch Deck Coach by Hiten
official.description: Reviews a pitch deck and reports what an investor is likely to understand, believe, question, and remember, then helps strengthen the story, evidence,...
